title: B.I. Semenoff, Candidate For Position Of Police Watchman

page_data.en:
Fm. 2
G. 35000-1-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C.M.S. No. REGISTRY. No. D 5706 Branch. Date 21 / 3 / 34）
Date ____ 1934

Subject (in full) B. I. Semenoff, candidate for position of Police Watchman.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by D. J. McEwen

With reference to the attached application by B.I. Semenoff
for a position as Police Watchman, this individual's antecedents
and record as known to this office are as follows:-

Boris Ivanovitch Semenoff, Russian, born 21.7.1892 in the
province of Voronej, Russia. He arrived in Shanghai in 1926
from Harbin, where he had resided since 1922. In Shanghai he
was employed as an electrician first with the British Royal
Engineers and later with the Advanced Ordnance Depot, No. 9
Hongkong Road from May 31, 1927, till October 31, 1933, when he
was discharged on the closing down of the Depot. Since that
time he has been without any fixed employment.

On August 29, 1931, Semenoff was charged before the
Shanghai Special District Court with "assault causing injury"
and was sentenced to 30 days imprisonment (vide attached extract
from Police report dated August 10, 1931).

He has good testimonial from the Advanced Ordnance Depot,
from which it appears that his services were retained by the
Depot notwithstanding the fact of his having served a term of
imprisonment.

Semenoff is registered with the Russian Emigrants Committee,
No. 6A Hongkong Road.

G. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.
（签名）
21 / 3 / 1934

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第二股。
报告

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 中央档案室 登记号 D 5706 分科。日期 1934年3月21日）
日期 ____ 1934年

事由（全称） B. I. Semenoff，警员职位候选人。

由 副督察 Prokofiev 呈报 经 D. J. McEwen 转呈

关于附呈的 B.I. Semenoff 申请警员职位一事，本处所知的该人背景及记录如下：-

Boris Ivanovitch Semenoff，俄国人，1892年7月21日出生于俄罗斯沃罗涅日省。他于1926年从哈尔滨抵达上海，此前自1922年起一直居住在哈尔滨。在上海，他先受雇于英国皇家工兵部队担任电工，后自1927年5月31日至1933年10月31日受雇于香港路9号的高级军械库，后因该军械库关闭而被解雇。自此以后，他一直没有任何固定职业。

1931年8月29日，Semenoff 在上海特区法院被指控犯有“伤人罪”，并被判处监禁30天（参见附呈的1931年8月10日警方报告摘录）。

他持有来自高级军械库的良好推荐信，从中可以看出，尽管他曾服刑，但该军械库仍继续留用他。

Semenoff 已在香港路6A号的俄国侨民委员会登记。

G. Prokofiev
副督察

特务科
副总监
（签名）
1934年3月21日

page_data.en:
EXTRACT
from Police report dated August 10,1931 ( File 1115,Wayside Stn ).

" At 6.30 p.m. on the 10-8-31,the Complainant,Mrs E.N.Dimi-
trieff,216 Alcock Road Terrace,walked along the above ter-
race,when she was abused by the accused who called her a
"prostitute".
The Complainant went home and complained to her husband,one
P.K.Shaposhnikoff of having been insulted.
They then together came out of the house,the Complainant
having a rolling pin in her hand. An altercation aroused
during which the accused got hold of a hammer and started to
fighting with P.K.Shaposhnikoff and the Complainant. The
latter used a rolling pin during this fight until the neigh-
bours had stopped it.
Both parties then proceeded to the station from where they
were sent to the General Hospital for treatment.Doctor's
chits read as follows:-
"that Mrs Dimitrieff is suffering from a badly lacerated
wound on the forehead and probably a fracture of the scull.
Detained in Hospital".
"That Mr.Shaposhnikoff is suffering from a lacerated wound
of the forehead,abrasions and bruising of right side of the
face,right shoulder and forearm".
"That Mr.Semenoff is suffering from two lacerated wounds of
the scalp".
When questioned,the accused admitted having beaten the above
two persons with a hammer,but denied having abused the Com-
plainant and that he started fighting first. It is believed
that fight was a result of a number of quarrels between the
two families,which had taken place from a long while ago.
The accused is charged accordingly and will be brought before
the S.D.Court to morrow A.M."
page_data.zh:
摘录
自1931年8月10日的警方报告（档案号 1115，路边巡捕房）。

“1931年8月10日下午6时30分，原告 E.N. Dimitrieff 夫人（住址：阿尔科克路露台216号）沿上述露台行走时，遭到被告辱骂，被告称其为‘妓女’。
原告回家后向其丈夫 P.K. Shaposhnikoff 抱怨受到侮辱。
随后两人一同走出家门，原告手中拿着一根擀面杖。期间发生争执，被告抓起一把锤子，开始与 P.K. Shaposhnikoff 及原告打斗。在打斗中，原告使用擀面杖还击，直至邻居上前制止。
随后双方前往巡捕房，并被送往广慈医院接受治疗。医生诊断书内容如下：-
‘Dimitrieff 夫人前额有严重撕裂伤，可能伴有颅骨骨折。留院观察。’
‘Shaposhnikoff 先生前额有撕裂伤，面部右侧、右肩及前臂有擦伤和瘀伤。’
‘Semenoff 先生头皮有两处撕裂伤。’
经讯问，被告承认曾用锤子殴打上述两人，但否认辱骂原告，并否认是他先动手打人。据信，此次斗殴是两家长期以来多次争吵的结果。
据此对被告提出指控，并将于明日上午提审至特区法院。”
